lines.zh: 我每走一步，符文亮一下。
lines.en: Each step I take lights a rune.

lines.zh: 秘境的地面承受得住我。
lines.en: The Mysterium ground holds my weight.
A golem walking sounds deep and slow.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，草会弯下去。
lines.en: Where I tread, the grass bends flat.

lines.zh: 我不会被推开，只会走过去。
lines.en: I am never pushed aside; I simply walk.
Runes crawl up my legs as I move.
Someone is far off; I close in slowly.
I crossed the stone steps without a sound.

lines.zh: 九十五点的身体，脚步声重。
lines.en: A ninety-five body makes heavy footsteps.
My knees do not bend very far.

lines.zh: 泥地留下我的脚印，很深。
lines.en: My footprints in the mud sink deep.
I have walked this road a long time.

lines.zh: 符文指着方向，我跟着走。
lines.en: The runes point the way; I follow.

lines.zh: 你听那声音，是我在靠近。
lines.en: That sound you hear is me approaching.
Standing still, my runes still glow.

lines.zh: 有只虫子爬上我的手臂。
lines.en: An insect is climbing up my arm.
I am calculating whether to move.
Mysterium wind passes through my seams.

lines.zh: 我身上的刻痕在慢慢变亮。
lines.en: The carvings on me brighten slowly.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，只需要等。
lines.en: I need no breath, only waiting.
The voice inside the stone is faint.
My shadow stands a little taller than a person.

lines.zh: 我把手掌摊开，什么也没有。
lines.en: I open my palm; there is nothing in it.
The runes count time; I do not care.
A chip of stone is stuck in my elbow.

lines.zh: 我不睡觉，只把眼睛暗下去。
lines.en: I do not sleep; I just dim my eyes.

lines.zh: 周围太安静，符文也不响。
lines.en: It is too quiet; even my runes are silent.
I wonder who carved me into being.

lines.zh: 我俯视你，像看一枚石子。
lines.en: I look down at you as at a pebble.

lines.zh: 你身上的光，不如我的符文。
lines.en: The light on you is dimmer than my runes.
You are searching for the cracks in me.
I have watched you a long while without blinking.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸让我想起活着。
lines.en: Your breathing reminds me what alive means.

lines.zh: 符文把你的轮廓记下来了。
lines.en: The runes have recorded your outline.
You should not be standing in my path.

lines.zh: 我眼里没有怒，只有判定。
lines.en: There is no anger in me, only judgment.

lines.zh: 你抬头的样子有点可怜。
lines.en: The way you look up is almost pitiable.

lines.zh: 我看得见你藏在身后的手。
lines.en: I can see the hand you hide behind you.

lines.zh: 你和我，差着一整块石头。
lines.en: Between us lies one whole block of stone.
Come closer and I will start moving.

lines.zh: 你砍在我符文上，火花四溅。
lines.en: You struck my rune and sparks flew.
The pain is not in flesh but in the carvings.

lines.zh: 我不会被击退，只会更慢。
lines.en: I am not knocked back, only slowed.

lines.zh: 这一下削掉我一层石皮。
lines.en: That took a layer of stone off me.

lines.zh: 我的符文闪了一下，没事。
lines.en: My runes flickered once; nothing more.

lines.zh: 你打得动我，但打不散我。
lines.en: You can move me, but you cannot break me.
The crack will remember your blade.

lines.zh: 我低头看伤口，像看天气。
lines.en: I look at the wound the way one checks weather.

lines.zh: 疼痛在石头里传得很远。
lines.en: Pain travels far inside stone.
How many more swings do you have?
Whatever you hold up, I will not trade.
I eat no food, only orders.
The runes need no offering from you.

lines.zh: 那块石头不错，但我不拿。
lines.en: That stone is decent, but I will not take it.

lines.zh: 你晃来晃去，我只觉得吵。
lines.en: All your waving does is make noise.

lines.zh: 我被刻下时，就没打算贪。
lines.en: When I was carved, greed was left out.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，我什么都不缺。
lines.en: Put it away; I lack nothing.

lines.zh: 你给的东西会让我变慢。
lines.en: What you offer would only slow me down.
My hands exist only for striking.

lines.zh: 别用铁引诱我，我不是野兽。
lines.en: Do not lure me with iron; I am no beast.
Bump into me and the pain is yours.
I did not give up a single step.

lines.zh: 你整个人撞上来，像撞墙。
lines.en: You hit me like walking into a wall.
To shove me, first shove a mountain.

lines.zh: 我的每一寸都是烧过的石头。
lines.en: Every inch of me is fired stone.

lines.zh: 你的盾碰到我，凹了一块。
lines.en: Your shield met me and dented.
Do not block the way; I do not go around.
I heard your bones make a sound.
I paused half a breath, then kept going.

lines.zh: 你用身体试了石头的重量。
lines.en: You tested stone's weight with your body.
I have no mate, only carvings.

lines.zh: 另一个傀儡在别的废墟里。
lines.en: Another golem stands in another ruin.

lines.zh: 我们不会相遇，只会站岗。
lines.en: We never meet; we only keep watch.

lines.zh: 石头和石头之间，没有婚约。
lines.en: Between stones there is no wedding vow.

lines.zh: 造我的人没给我这份心。
lines.en: My maker gave me no such heart.

lines.zh: 秘境里没有小傀儡出生。
lines.en: No small golems are born in Mysterium.

lines.zh: 和我一样的石头，都不说话。
lines.en: Stones like me never speak to each other.
Loneliness means little to stone.
We link through runes, and it is cold.
I need no one to wait for me.
I pick up a stone and put it back.
A rune fallen on the ground belongs to me.
I take only what should be taken.

lines.zh: 这块碎片是从我身上掉的。
lines.en: This chip fell off my own body.
The sword you dropped, I leave it.
I lift things only to set them down.

lines.zh: 符文要摆正，我的指节太粗。
lines.en: The rune must sit straight, but my knuckles are thick.
Rune stones must go back on their pedestals.
I do not collect; I restore.

lines.zh: 你丢的东西，踩在我脚下。
lines.en: What you dropped is under my foot.
You have stepped into forbidden ground.
The runes turning toward you is the verdict.
I have marked you; you will not leave.

lines.zh: 九点的重量，落在你身上。
lines.en: Nine points of weight, landing on you.
You moved a stone you should not have.
Once I start walking, I do not stop.
Your name has been carved in.

lines.zh: 你退后也没用，我记得路。
lines.en: Retreat will not help; I know the way.

lines.zh: 这是我守的地方，你不该来。
lines.en: This is my ground; you should not be here.
I see you, head to foot.
The runes glow only on you.
Every rune is lit; you should understand.

lines.zh: 你挡在门前，生意就来了。
lines.en: You stand before the door; so it begins.

lines.zh: 我确认过了，你是入侵者。
lines.en: I have confirmed it: you are an intruder.

lines.zh: 我数着你到我之间的石阶。
lines.en: I count the stone steps between us.
Three steps back from you, three forward from me.
My runes have locked onto you.
You circle; I do not circle.
Your footsteps are getting more scattered.

lines.zh: 我举起手臂，符文也举起来。
lines.en: I raise my arm; the runes rise with it.
Do not think of striking my back.

lines.zh: 我不用看也知道你在哪。
lines.en: I know where you are without looking.
You have only this one passage left.

lines.zh: 我等你自己走进攻击范围。
lines.en: I wait for you to enter my reach.

lines.zh: 你的影子够不到我的膝盖。
lines.en: Your shadow does not reach my knees.
In this moment I have the angle.

lines.zh: 你停，我也停；这不叫仁慈。
lines.en: You stop, I stop; this is not mercy.
The runes are counting down; you cannot hear.
You will remember this blow for a long time.
Stone meeting bone makes a muffled crack.
I carry no weapon; my hand is one.

lines.zh: 你被砸退了，我还在原地。
lines.en: You were knocked back; I have not moved.
Nine points of force; one is enough.
I brought my fist down and the iron bent.
I strike you only because you block the way.

lines.zh: 这一下不算重，下一记才算。
lines.en: That was light; the next one counts.

lines.zh: 你听见石头落地的声音吗？
lines.en: Did you hear the sound of stone landing?

lines.zh: 符文顺着我的拳头烧起来。
lines.en: Runes burn along my fist as it lands.
After the strike I return to my post.
You want to block; you cannot block this.
Bone sounds more brittle than stone.

lines.zh: 我倒要看看你还站得住。
lines.en: Let us see if you can still stand.
The pedestal cracked and I stood up.
Runes lit from my head to my feet.
I woke and first checked my duty.
Mysterium has one more watcher now.
I still carry rubble on my body.
These carvings are new, not yet worn.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己睡了多久。
lines.en: I do not know how long I slept.
Wind moves through the seams in me.
I tried clenching my fist; stone ground.

lines.zh: 职责在符文里，不在心里。
lines.en: Duty lives in the runes, not the heart.
I planted my feet and sank into soil.
This ruin asks me to keep watch.

lines.zh: 我听见有人在附近呼吸。
lines.en: I hear someone breathing nearby.
My first movement comes stiff in the joints.

lines.zh: 火烤得符文发红，很难受。
lines.en: Fire heats my runes red; it is unpleasant.
I landed and made a crater.
Water fills my seams and I grow heavy.
The blast took half my face away.
An arrow is stuck in my shoulder seam.

lines.zh: 这东西能烧到石头里面。
lines.en: This thing burns inside the stone itself.

lines.zh: 没有敌人，我的符文慢慢熄。
lines.en: With no enemy, my runes slowly go out.
Lightning made my runes jump wildly.
In the void, even stone has no weight.
